title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
summaryEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較南備讚瀨戶大橋型懸索橋在不同鋼絲直徑下的主纜狀態。主纜 271 股×127 根 = 34,417 根鋼絲，張力約 45,000 t（≈ 441 MN），主纜直徑 107 cm（毛面積 0.899 m²）。若鋼絲直徑 5.10 mm，單絲面積 20.4 mm²，總面積 ≈ 0.703 m²，應力 ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm²，對 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲的安全係數 ≈ 2.50，空隙率 ≈ 22%。若直徑為 5.00 mm，單絲 19.6 mm²、總面積 ≈ 0.676 m²，應力 ≈ 653 N/mm²、係數 ≈ 2.40，空隙率 ≈ 25%；若為 5.20 mm，總面積 ≈ 0.731 m²、係數 ≈ 2.60、空隙率 ≈ 19%。可見「約 5 mm」的 0.1 mm 差異就會改變安全係數約 4% 與空隙率約 3 個百分點。除公開的股數、直徑與張力外，數值為教學假設，不代表瀨戶大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the cable state of a Minami Bisan-Seto type suspension bridge for different wire diameters. The cable has 271 strands × 127 wires = 34,417 wires, a tension of about 45,000 t (≈ 441 MN) and a diameter of 107 cm (gross area 0.899 m²). With 5.10 mm wire, each wire is 20.4 mm², the total area ≈ 0.703 m², the stress ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm², the safety factor on 1,570 N/mm² wire ≈ 2.50 and the void ratio ≈ 22%. With 5.00 mm wire, each is 19.6 mm², the total ≈ 0.676 m², the stress ≈ 653 N/mm², the factor ≈ 2.40 and voids ≈ 25%; with 5.20 mm, the total ≈ 0.731 m², the factor ≈ 2.60 and voids ≈ 19%. A 0.1 mm difference within ‘about 5 mm’ changes the safety factor by about 4% and the void ratio by about 3 points. Apart from the published strand count, diameter and tension, values are teaching assumptions, not Seto Ohashi design calculations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」與「鐵路通行與連續懸索橋」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" and "Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Type layout over 9.4 km” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions. Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Type layout over 9.4 km” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sea-crossing link should use the same most advanced bridge type throughout." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Type layout over 9.4 km”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Type layout over 9.4 km” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。若懸索橋垂跨比取 1/10，三座懸索橋主纜垂度約為 94 m、99 m 與 110 m，決定了塔高的主要部分。垂跨比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. With a 1/10 sag ratio, the three suspension bridges' cable sags would be about 94 m, 99 m and 110 m, setting most of each tower's height. The sag ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Type layout over 9.4 km” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型跨海工程的配置報告應以表格比較各段的水深、航道、基礎數與橋型方案，並保存被淘汰方案的理由；日後若有新增航道需求或維修策略變更，可回到此基準評估影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The layout report for a major sea crossing should tabulate water depth, channel, foundation count and type options for each segment and keep the reasons for rejected options, so later new channel demands or maintenance strategy changes can be assessed against that baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三跨連續加勁桁」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-span continuous truss” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。把加勁桁在塔處做成連續，能大幅減少這個折角，代價是塔處的彎矩與支承反力增加，以及溫度與活載下更複雜的縱向位移。這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三跨連續加勁桁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track. Making the stiffening truss continuous over the towers greatly reduces this kink, at the price of larger bending moments and bearing reactions at the towers and more complex longitudinal movement under temperature and live load. This was one of the key choices that made Seto Ohashi a road–rail suspension bridge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three-span continuous truss” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-span continuous truss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。取主跨 L = 1,100 m、列車荷重下最大撓度 δ = 2.0 m：θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad；若塔處為鉸接，兩側轉角相加的折角可達約 0.0145 rad。連續構造把折角限制在梁的連續曲率內，鐵路容許折角則遠小於此值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Continuity keeps the angle within the girder's smooth curvature, while the permissible rail kink is far smaller. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 北、南備讚瀨戶大橋相鄰而建，兩橋之間共用一座錨碇，兩側主纜的索股在錨碇內交叉錨定：北備讚為 234 股、南備讚為 271 股，業主稱這種構造為世界首例。每股由 127 根直徑約 5 mm 的平行鋼絲排成六角形，不扭絞。南備讚瀨戶大橋的主纜最大，直徑 107 cm，承受約 45,000 t 的張力。共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用錨碇索股交叉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto stand side by side and share one anchorage between them, where the strands of both cables cross and are anchored: 234 strands for Kita Bisan-Seto and 271 for Minami Bisan-Seto, a structure the owner calls a world first. Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted. Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is the largest, 107 cm in diameter and carrying about 45,000 t of tension. The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shared anchorage strand crossing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels" and "Truss erection and the jacked-open closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「起重船牽引導索」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crane-ship pilot rope” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 過去的懸索橋把第一條導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過海峽，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋航道繁忙，因此改以起重船把導索吊在高處跨越。導索就位後，約 10 條較粗的鋼索架在其上，鋪上鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，形成寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m 的貓道，貓道之間以橫向便橋連接。索股在架設前 4 年以上就開始製造，每股捲在重近 40 t 的捲盤上，以貨運列車陸運，再以牽引索在兩座錨碇間拉送。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「起重船牽引導索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earlier suspension bridges floated the first pilot rope on buoys and towed it across by boat, which meant closing the channel; Seto Ohashi's channels were too busy, so a crane ship held the pilot rope high as it crossed. With the pilot rope in place, about ten heavier ropes were laid on it and covered with wire mesh and a double fibre net to form a catwalk 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. Strand fabrication began more than four years before erection; each strand was wound on a reel weighing nearly 40 t, carried overland by freight train and hauled between the anchorages by a traction rope. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crane-ship pilot rope” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「貓道只是臨時走道，設計上不需要考慮風與荷重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and needs no wind or load design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「起重船牽引導索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 導索、貓道與 40 噸索股捲盤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pilot rope, catwalks and 40 t strand reels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「起重船牽引導索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crane-ship pilot rope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單股重量 W = n·a·L·ρ。取 127 根、每根 20.4 mm²、索股長 1,800 m、鋼密度 7,850 kg/m³：W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t，加上捲盤後接近公開的「近 40 t」。若索股長 2,000 m，單股約 40.7 t，可能超過捲盤與運輸限制。索股長度與單絲面積為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Strand weight W = n·a·L·ρ. With 127 wires of 20.4 mm², a strand length of 1,800 m and steel at 7,850 kg/m³: W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t, close to the published ‘nearly 40 t’ once the reel is added. A 2,000 m strand would weigh about 40.7 t and could exceed reel and transport limits. Strand length and wire area are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：導索跨越前與航道主管機關確認作業時段與起重船位置，跨越中量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後做荷重與防風試驗、檢查網片與扶手；每股牽引前核對捲盤編號、長度標記與錨頭，牽引後量測垂度並記錄溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the crossing confirm working hours and crane-ship position with the navigation authority and measure the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built carry out load and wind checks and inspect mesh and handrails; before hauling each strand check reel number, length marks and sockets, and after hauling measure sag and record temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With 127 wires of 20.4 mm², a strand length of 1,800 m and steel at 7,850 kg/m³: W = 127×20.4×10⁻⁶×1,800×7,850 ≈ 36.6 t, close to the published ‘nearly 40 t’ once the reel is added. A 2,000 m strand would weigh about 40.7 t and could exceed reel and transport limits. Strand length and wire area are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1,500 t tower blocks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主記載加勁桁在工廠先做全尺寸立體預組以確認精度，再塗裝並依現場進度出貨。南備讚瀨戶大橋把每座塔附近四個格間約 1,500 t 在工廠組成大塊，由起重船一次吊放，提早騰出橋上空間給後續的架設設備；之後以兩個格間為一組，以船運到塔邊吊起、用台車往前送，再由前端吊機安裝，反覆循環。隨著架設推進主纜形狀大幅變化，需要測量並平衡兩側進度。架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner records that the stiffening truss was fully trial-assembled in three dimensions at the factory to confirm accuracy before painting and shipping to suit the site schedule. At Minami Bisan-Seto the four panels near each tower, about 1,500 t, were assembled into a large block and set by a crane ship in one lift, clearing the deck early for the following erection equipment; after that two-panel units were shipped to the tower, lifted, moved forward on carriages and placed by a crane at the leading end, in a repeating cycle. The cable shape changed greatly as erection advanced, requiring surveys and balanced progress on both sides. After about a year the two fronts met at mid-span; before the closure panel went in, jacks at the towers pulled the truss toward the towers to widen the gap, then were released. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “1,500 t tower blocks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1,500 t tower blocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：合龍間隙對溫度敏感：兩側各約 550 m 的桁架，溫度上升 10 °C 時間隙縮小 ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m。若合龍段需要 50 mm 的安裝餘裕，而當時溫度比設計高 5 °C（間隙少約 66 mm），就必須以千斤頂拉開約 116 mm 或等待降溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The closure gap is temperature sensitive: with about 550 m of truss on each side, a 10 °C rise closes the gap by ΔL = 2×550×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 0.132 m. If the closure panel needs 50 mm of fitting clearance and the temperature is 5 °C above design (gap about 66 mm short), jacks must open about 116 mm or the team must wait for cooling. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Truss erection and the jacked-open closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「1,500 噸塔邊大塊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “1,500 t tower blocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個架設循環後量測主纜垂度、桁架高程與兩側進度差，與施工階段分析比較；合龍前連續數小時量測間隙與桁架溫度，建立間隙—溫度關係，選定合龍時段，並記錄千斤頂拉力與行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each cycle measure cable sag, truss levels and the progress difference between sides against the stage analysis; before closure measure gap and truss temperature continuously for several hours to build a gap–temperature relation, choose the closure window, and log jack force and stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍作業應有書面的溫度窗口、千斤頂容許拉力、間隙量測方法與停止條件，並由設計者確認合龍時的結構狀態；工廠全尺寸預組的量測紀錄須隨構件交付，作為現場比對依據。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 加勁桁架吊裝與合龍拉開：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 若兩側架設進度不平衡，塔頂受不平衡水平力而偏位，主纜形狀偏離預測，合龍時兩端高程與角度對不上；在溫度上升時強行嵌入合龍段，可能使接頭產生強迫應力或無法栓接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：架設約一年後兩側在跨中會合，最後一段合龍前以塔邊的千斤頂把桁架往塔方向拉，擴大合龍間隙，嵌入後再放鬆。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預組量測與誤差累積控制」與「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" and "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「工廠全尺寸預組」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full factory trial assembly” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋加勁桁由數百個構件與接頭組成，每個接頭的小誤差在長跨中累積，最後決定合龍處能否對上、吊索位置是否與索夾一致，以及鐵路軌道是否平順。工廠全尺寸立體預組讓誤差在地面上就被發現並修正，而不是到了海上高空才發現孔位不合。誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「工廠全尺寸預組」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A suspension stiffening truss is made of hundreds of members and joints, and small errors at each joint accumulate along a long span, deciding whether the closure fits, whether hanger positions match the cable bands and whether the rail track is smooth. Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea. Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full factory trial assembly” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「工廠全尺寸預組」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full factory trial assembly”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Full three-dimensional trial assembly in the factory finds and fixes errors on the ground rather than discovering mismatched holes high above the sea.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「預組量測與誤差累積控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「工廠全尺寸預組」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full factory trial assembly” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。若系統誤差在預組中被找出並修正到 0.2 mm，累積只剩 20 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. If trial assembly finds the systematic error and cuts it to 0.2 mm, the accumulation is only 20 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。若系統誤差在預組中被找出並修正到 0.2 mm，累積只剩 20 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. If trial assembly finds the systematic error and cuts it to 0.2 mm, the accumulation is only 20 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預組量測與誤差累積控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。

100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm。
optionsEn: Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary.
A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.
With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm.
quiz.explanation: 100 個接頭、各自隨機誤差 ±3 mm 時，累積誤差約 √100×3 = ±30 mm；若每個接頭另有 1 mm 同向系統誤差，累積 100×1 = 100 mm，遠大於隨機部分。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 100 joints each carrying a random error of ±3 mm, the accumulated error is about √100×3 = ±30 mm; an additional 1 mm systematic error per joint in the same direction accumulates to 100×1 = 100 mm, far larger than the random part. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「工廠全尺寸預組」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full factory trial assembly” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預組時在固定溫度下以全站儀與鋼尺量測節點座標、全長、拱度與對角線，並修正量具溫度；把量測結果與設計座標比較，統計每節誤差的平均（系統）與標準差（隨機），超出允差的構件在出廠前修正並重新量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial assembly survey node coordinates, overall length, camber and diagonals by total station and steel tape at a stable temperature, correcting instrument temperature; compare results with design coordinates, separating the mean (systematic) and standard deviation (random) of panel errors, and correct and re-measure members outside tolerance before shipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造規範應同時規定單構件允差與累積允差，並要求以統計方式報告預組誤差；量具校正、量測溫度與參考點須有紀錄，預組報告是出廠放行的停留點文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Fabrication specifications should set both member tolerances and accumulated tolerances and require trial-assembly errors to be reported statistically; instrument calibration, survey temperature and reference points must be recorded, and the trial-assembly report is the hold-point document for release from the factory.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 預組量測與誤差累積控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工廠全尺寸預組」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full factory trial assembly” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點；鐵路軌道也可能因累積線形誤差而需要大量調整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints; accumulated profile error may also require extensive rail-track adjustment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：誤差分為隨機誤差與系統誤差：隨機誤差會部分互相抵消，系統誤差（例如量尺溫度未修正、模具偏差）則每一節都朝同一方向累積，是預組最需要抓出來的對象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Errors are random or systematic: random errors partly cancel, while systematic ones, such as an uncorrected tape temperature or a jig offset, accumulate in the same direction at every panel and are what trial assembly most needs to catch.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一個構件都在允差內，整座橋就一定能準確合龍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every member is within tolerance, the whole bridge will close accurately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預組量測與誤差累積控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若省略預組或只做局部預組，系統誤差到現場才浮現，可能必須在海上擴孔、加墊板或重新製造構件，延誤工期並在接頭留下疲勞弱點。

Skipping or limiting trial assembly lets systematic errors surface on site, forcing hole reaming, shims or refabrication at sea, delaying the work and leaving fatigue weak spots at joints.
A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「沉箱沉放繫留」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caisson mooring during sinking” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。沉放時先在海底預埋重約 900 t 的錨，沉箱上的絞車以鋼索連到錨上抵抗潮流，一邊注水下沉一邊調整位置，最後由大型起重船扶持控制姿態軟著陸。容許的設置誤差為 50 cm，業主指出所有沉箱都在此範圍內完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「沉箱沉放繫留」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. For sinking, an anchor of about 900 t was pre-placed on the seabed and winches on the caisson pulled on wires to it against the tide, adjusting position as water was admitted, with a large crane vessel finally holding the caisson to control its attitude for a soft landing. The allowable placement error was 50 cm, and the owner states every caisson was placed within it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Caisson mooring during sinking” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「沉箱沉放繫留」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Caisson mooring during sinking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson towing window and placement acceptance" is correct?
options: 沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。

業主記載沉箱出塢後以 12 艘拖船慢速拖到橋位，一旦開始拖航就不能中途停下，因此只在氣象與海象資料顯示至少 4 天穩定時才出發。
optionsEn: A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.

quiz.explanationEn: The owner records that after leaving the dock each caisson was towed slowly to site by 12 tugs; once towing began it could not stop, so departure waited for weather and sea data showing at least four stable days. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉箱拖航窗口與定位驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson towing window and placement acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉箱沉放繫留」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caisson mooring during sinking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。取沉放中迎流面積 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m²、C_D = 1.2、流速 1.5 m/s：F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN（約 317 t 力），須由絞車、錨與起重船共同抵抗；流速增為 2.0 m/s 時 F 增為約 5.5 MN。面積、係數與流速為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². With a projected area during sinking of 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m², C_D = 1.2 and current 1.5 m/s: F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN (about 317 t-force), resisted jointly by winches, anchor and crane vessel; at 2.0 m/s F rises to about 5.5 MN. Area, coefficient and current are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沉放全程以測量系統即時追蹤沉箱平面位置、高程與傾斜，並與潮流預報比對選擇平潮時段；著地後立即量測四角高程與中心座標，與 50 cm 容許誤差比較，合格後才開始投放骨材與注入砂漿。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track plan position, level and tilt in real time throughout sinking, choosing slack-water windows from tidal forecasts; immediately after landing measure corner levels and centre coordinates against the 50 cm tolerance, and begin aggregate placement and mortar injection only after acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 潮流拖曳力 F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U²。取沉放中迎流面積 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m²、C_D = 1.2、流速 1.5 m/s：F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN（約 317 t 力），須由絞車、錨與起重船共同抵抗；流速增為 2.0 m/s 時 F 增為約 5.5 MN。面積、係數與流速為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tidal drag F = ½ρ·C_D·A·U². With a projected area during sinking of 75 m×30 m = 2,250 m², C_D = 1.2 and current 1.5 m/s: F = 0.5×1,025×1.2×2,250×1.5² ≈ 3.11 MN (about 317 t-force), resisted jointly by winches, anchor and crane vessel; at 2.0 m/s F rises to about 5.5 MN. Area, coefficient and current are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Galvanised wire and dry air” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主說明，因島、大鳴門、大島與瀨戶大橋等較早的懸索橋，主纜採用鍍鋅鋼絲加防鏽劑與纏絲包覆；後來檢查舊有懸索橋時，拆開纏絲發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，於是開發把乾燥空氣送入主纜的系統，並裝設在本州四國連絡橋的所有懸索橋。鍍鋅層是犧牲性的：只要纜內潮濕，鋅就逐年消耗，耗盡後鋼絲本體才開始生鏽。乾燥空氣不是取代鍍鋅，而是把鋅的消耗速度降到幾乎為零，讓既有的保護層長期有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner explains that earlier suspension bridges such as Innoshima, Ohnaruto, Ohshima and Seto Ohashi used galvanised wire with a rust inhibitor and wrapping; later inspections of existing suspension bridges found rust on wires once the wrapping was removed, so a system blowing dry air into the main cables was developed and installed on all the Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges. Galvanising is sacrificial: while the cable interior is damp, zinc is consumed year by year, and only when it is gone does the steel itself rust. Dry air does not replace galvanising; it cuts zinc consumption to nearly zero so the existing protection stays effective for the long term. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Galvanised wire and dry air” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絲有鍍鋅層，所以主纜內部潮濕也不會有問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the wire is galvanised, a damp cable interior is not a problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Galvanised wire and dry air”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 主纜鍍鋅層壽命與乾燥空氣改善：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zinc-coating life and improved dry-air injection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鍍鋅鋼絲與乾燥空氣」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Galvanised wire and dry air” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 相當於厚度 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm。若潮濕纜內鋅的消耗率為 4 μm/年，約 42/4 ≈ 10.5 年即耗盡；若乾燥空氣把消耗率降到 0.1 μm/年，約需 420 年。消耗率為教學假設，實際值依濕度、氯鹽與溫度而定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A zinc mass of 300 g/m² corresponds to 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm. If zinc is consumed at 4 μm a year in a damp cable, it is gone in about 42/4 ≈ 10.5 years; if dry air cuts the rate to 0.1 μm a year, it lasts about 420 years. Rates are teaching assumptions; real values depend on humidity, chlorides and temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically open inspection windows at cable low points and near bands, wedge wires apart to grade zinc condition and rust, and sample remaining zinc; compare humidity records at inlets and outlets to confirm the improved dry-air system keeps every section below the management target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Galvanised wire and dry air” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期在主纜低點與索夾附近開窗，以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查鍍鋅層與鏽蝕等級，並取樣量測剩餘鋅量；同時比較送氣與排氣口的濕度紀錄，確認改善後的乾燥空氣系統讓各區段維持在管理目標以下。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 本州四國連絡橋共約 400 萬 m² 的塗裝面積，業主預估塗裝將佔未來維護費用約一半，因此延長重塗週期是生命週期成本的主要策略；瀨戶大橋使用了抗紫外線的塗料，並以在固定點定期量測塗膜厚度決定重塗時機。加勁桁上設有供檢修車行駛的軌道，維護人員可沿桁架移動檢查。瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「公路鐵路並存的維護」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「公路鐵路並存的維護」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance with road and rail” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。設面漆初始厚度 d₀ = 30 μm、重塗門檻 d_min = 5 μm、年損耗 r = 1.0 μm/年：t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 年；若抗紫外線塗料把 r 降到 0.6 μm/年，t ≈ 42 年，重塗次數減少約四成。厚度與損耗率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. With an initial top-coat thickness d₀ = 30 μm, a repaint threshold d_min = 5 μm and wear r = 1.0 μm a year: t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 years; if a UV-resistant paint cuts r to 0.6 μm a year, t ≈ 42 years and the number of repaints falls by about 40%. Thicknesses and wear rates are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 塗膜壽命 t = (d₀ − d_min)/r。設面漆初始厚度 d₀ = 30 μm、重塗門檻 d_min = 5 μm、年損耗 r = 1.0 μm/年：t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 年；若抗紫外線塗料把 r 降到 0.6 μm/年，t ≈ 42 年，重塗次數減少約四成。厚度與損耗率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Coating life t = (d₀ − d_min)/r. With an initial top-coat thickness d₀ = 30 μm, a repaint threshold d_min = 5 μm and wear r = 1.0 μm a year: t = (30 − 5)/1.0 = 25 years; if a UV-resistant paint cuts r to 0.6 μm a year, t ≈ 42 years and the number of repaints falls by about 40%. Thicknesses and wear rates are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「公路鐵路並存的維護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance with road and rail” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在各橋固定測點定期以膜厚計量測塗膜厚度，建立每個區位的損耗率並預測重塗時程；檢查作業前由道路與鐵路兩方確認作業時段、檢修車行駛路線與緊急撤離程序，作業後把發現事項輸入檢查資料庫並以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure film thickness at fixed points on every bridge periodically, deriving wear rates per zone to forecast repainting; before inspection confirm work windows, maintenance-vehicle routes and emergency withdrawal with both road and rail parties, and afterwards enter findings into the inspection database and update the plan through a PDCA cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應把塗膜量測點、損耗率、預測重塗年份與實際作業紀錄放在同一系統，並與鐵路營運單位簽訂年度作業時段協議；交接文件須包含檢修軌道與檢修車的檢查與維修程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should keep film-thickness points, wear rates, forecast repaint years and actual work records in one system and agree annual work windows with the railway operator; handover documents must include inspection and maintenance procedures for the maintenance rails and vehicles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 塗膜管理與夜間檢查的協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coating management and night-time inspection coordination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「公路鐵路並存的維護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance with road and rail” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若重塗時機只依年數而不量測膜厚，可能在塗膜仍良好時過早重塗，或在已露底時才處理，鋼材開始鏽蝕；道路與鐵路的作業時段未協調，檢查覆蓋率不足，部分區段長期未被近距離檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timing repainting by age without measuring film thickness either repaints too early while coatings are fine or too late after steel is exposed and rusting; uncoordinated road and rail work windows reduce inspection coverage, leaving some zones without close inspection for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：瀨戶大橋上層是高速公路、下層是鐵路，任何檢查或修繕都要同時協調道路交通管制與鐵路的夜間作業時段，近年業主仍持續進行夜間的打音檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With an expressway above and a railway below, every inspection or repair must coordinate road traffic management with night-time railway work windows, and the owner continues night-time hammer-sounding inspections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋塗裝只要定期全面重塗就好，不需要量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel bridge coatings just need periodic full repainting; measurement is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
